Regulation: B.C. Reg. 87/2026
Made under: Provincial Sales Tax Act
Published in: No. 10 – B.C. Regs. 83 to 93, June 2, 2026
Deposit date: May 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 87/2026, deposited May 22, 2026, under thePROVINCIAL SALES TAX ACT[section 240]. Order in Council 199/2026, approved and ordered May 22, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that (a)	the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, and (b)	effective November 1, 2026, the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; L. BEARE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Schedule 1 of the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended (a)	in column 4 of item 12.1 by striking out "July 1, 2026" and substituting "July 1, 2031", and (b)	in column 4 of item 38.1 by striking out "August 1, 2026" and substituting "August 1, 2031". 1	Schedule 2 of the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended (a)	in column 3 of item 11 by striking out "2%" and substituting "3%", and (b)	in column 4 of item 11 by striking out "November 1, 2026" and substituting "November 1, 2031". minutes_briefs.title: BC extends accommodation area tax deadlines and raises rate to 3% in one area
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has updated its Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation. This regulation lets certain areas charge an extra tax on short-term accommodation like hotels and motels. Two areas had their tax approval extended by five years, so they can keep charging the tax until 2031. One area will see its tax rate go up from 2% to 3% starting November 1, 2026. This means if you run a hotel, motel, or other short-term rental in one of these areas, you may need to collect more tax from guests starting this fall.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you operate short-term accommodation in the area affected by the rate increase, update your billing systems to charge 3% tax starting November 1, 2026.

key_dates.label: Accommodation area tax rate increase to 3% takes effect (BC)
